defaultOptions.description:
Default values to provide for the task. Caller-provided option values (e.g. `completion#options`)
will be merged and take precedence.

title:
Interface that represents a unified "completion" API for LLMs, based on the OpenAi chat completion API:
{@link https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat}.
See {@link GenaiCore.Llm.AzureOpenAi.Model} and {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Completion.Client} as examples
of types implementing this interface.
name: GenaiCore.Llm.Completion
